text: Arena handling in mon_take_hit, with the rest of arena mode (not begun; see parity/DEFERRALS.md).

The projectile path and command front-ends: ranged_helper, do_cmd_fire, do_cmd_throw, do_cmd_fire_at_nearest (project_path, missile display events, ammo/quiver selection, piercing via TMD_POWERSHOT, drop_near and the actual application of breakage_chance).
O-combat ranged (birth_percent_damage): o_ranged_damage, o_critical_shot, and the o-ranged-critical constants/levels.
Knowledge / learning: missile_learn_on_ranged_attack, equip_learn_on_ ranged_attack, learn_brand_slay_from_launch/throw.
Temporary brands/slays (improve_attack_modifier obj == NULL path).
Curse contributions to object_to_hit/to_dam/weight.

DAMAGE: player path complete (reduction, show_damage message, take_hit, killer for player/none sources). The monster-target and decoy branches are ported in the game layer (game/effect-monster.ts, game/project-monster.ts, and the decoy at effect-general.ts:199). The registry-derived killer description is the one real remainder - see parity/DEFERRALS.md, MDESC_DIED_FROM.

TIMED_INC: player path complete including the `other` re-up rule; decoy destruction and the TMD->MON_TMD mapping for monster targets are both ported in the game layer (effect-general.ts:768 maps TMD.AFRAID to MON_TMD.FEAR).

monster_turn_multiply's no-breeding-in-arena guard rides monster reproduction (unported); mon_take_nonplayer_hit's arena floor (monsters cannot kill the arena opponent) is moot while the arena holds exactly one monster.
ALTER_REALITY's arena guard rides that (unported, deprecated upstream) effect; TELEPORT_LEVEL in arenas is blocked by the same generate_level flow it signals.
The arena event banners / EVENT_GEN_LEVEL_START("arena") ride presentation (#25).

Locked / jammed doors, do_cmd_lock_door: door locks are the "door lock" trap upstream - all land with trap.c (#21) through the isLockedDoor / pickLock seams (supplied at session/game.ts:1716); the disarm door-lock branch is a real remainder.
The swap-digger machinery (player_best_digger + the temporary calc_bonuses with a swapped weapon): digging reads the wielded state's DIGGING skill.
do_cmd_alter_aux's chest and floor-trap-disarm fallback branches (alter IS bound, to "+", at web/src/main.ts:8090).
do_cmd_steal (shapechanged players, #22); run / explore / pathfind / navigate (player-path.c, #24); command repetition and the count_feats single-target direction inference (UI); messages are hooks.
breath_dam(type, mon->hp) for monster breath damage (#19); the dice value is used until then.
resolveAimedTarget's monster targeting (confused direction, target-monster, decoy) and the target system (target_okay / target_get provide env.aimed) - #19 / #24.
PROJECT_LOS_AWARE's awareness-gated notice difference (a UI/notice nuance); both codes apply the same projection. BOLT_AWARE's PROJECT_AWARE flag is the same notice nuance (#25).
EF_LASH's monster-vs-monster target and decoy branches (#19); the target is the player.

Chest-trap identification inside DETECT_TRAPS (obj->known pval) rides object knowledge; ignore_item_ok rides ignore (#24); the DTRAP border display, item/monster list redraws and detection sounds ride #25/#26.
Invisible-monster lore learning (rf_on lore RF_INVISIBLE) and the monster recall window ride lore (#24).

The attack effect handlers (EF_BOLT / BALL / BREATH / ...) are dispatched through the projection-casting spine (game/project-cast.ts) and are wired into the registry in the next increment via a game env slot.
A real damage reduction and player_inc_check state from calc_bonuses replace the zero / allow-all defaults.
The equipment letter (gear_to_label) and ODESC_BASE description in the disenchant messages ride the display layer (#25); the kind's base name is used.
obj->known->to_h/to_d/to_a display sync - knowledge is rune-based here (obj/knowledge.ts).
Monster-AI decoy targeting (monster_is_decoyed and the decoy's death) rides lore/AI (#24); the decoy grid is tracked and the glyph trap is real.

DRAIN_MANA's monster-vs-monster branch (MON_TMD_DISEN on the target monster) rides monster-spell targeting (#19); update_smart_learn (PF_NO_MANA) rides lore (#24). MDESC monster names ride the display layer (#25); the race name stands in.
DRAIN_STAT's show_damage " (%d)" suffix is the options system (#30); likewise RECALL's birth_no_recall / birth_levels_persist options and total_winner. Arena levels are not modelled.

ODESC_BASE / ODESC_FULL descriptions and gear letters ride the display layer (#25); the kind's base name is used. obj->known->to_h/to_d/to_a display sync rides rune-based knowledge. The recharge_pow failure-rate display (ui-object.c) rides #25.
REMOVE_CURSE's known-twin curse tester (obj->known->curses) is read from the live curses (knowledge is rune-based); show_damage (#30).
CURSE_ARMOR/WEAPON's total_weight upkeep rides the gear weight bookkeeping; history_lose_artifact rides history (#24).
EVENT_INPUT_FLUSH and the PN_COMBINE / PR_ redraws ride presentation.
Monster casts never reach these handlers (mon-cast deps omit the item env); upstream reaches them only through player commands too.

Every formerly-deferred handler is now DONE: EF_WONDER / EF_BIZARRE (game-effect-attack / general), EF_COMMAND (game-mon-cmd), EF_PROBE (mon-lore), EF_SHAPECHANGE (game-shape) and EF_SINGLE_COMBAT (game-arena) - the effect_kind[] surface is fully ported.

target_set_closest's bookkeeping (target_set_monster, healthWho, the "No Available Target." / "%s is targeted." messages) is now the real game/target.ts implementation; the messages flow through state.msg (the world-event sink), not the effect context's.

MDESC names, message_pain grammar and MSG_TELEPORT sound ride the display layer (#25) - the race name stands in and pain messages are reduced to the MON_MSG_FLEE_IN_TERROR flee line; show_damage (#30).

MOVE_ATTACK's move_player is reduced to movePlayer + updateFov + onPlayerMoved (no autopickup / disturb on the pass-through grids); the early-death energy refund marked "Should return some energy" upstream is unimplemented there too.
The arena-level guard (player->upkeep->arena_level): arenas are not modelled.
The PR_MONLIST / PR_HEALTH redraws are UI concerns.
MDESC monster names and possessives (monster_desc) ride the display layer (#25); the race name and "its" stand in.
The arena-level guard (player->upkeep->arena_level) - arenas are not modelled (SINGLE_COMBAT rides later #24 work).
sound(message_type) rides the sound system (#26); the msgt channel on the blind message rides presentation (#25).

player_handle_post_move / handle_stuff: the FOV / light / target refresh after a teleport is the injected onPlayerPostMove / onMonsterPostMove hook (the game-loop layer wires update_view, as it already does for movement).
The OF_NO_TELEPORT curse and its equip_learn_flag: injected as hasNoTeleport / onLearnNoTeleport (object flags on the player are calc_bonuses / gear state, #13 rune learning).

monster_target_monster (the monster-vs-monster targetMonster) and the Dimension Door aim prompt (getAimTarget): monster spells (#19) and targeting (#24); target_able / target_set_monster / target_set_location clears are the same targeting subsystem.

dungeon_get_next_level / dungeon_change_level and is_quest / birth_force_descend for TELEPORT_LEVEL: level change and quests (#23); injected as getNextLevel / changeLevel / isQuest / forceDescend / maxPlayerDepth / maxDepth.

The trap / glyph-ward / damaging-terrain / web destination predicates (square_isplayertrap / _iswarded / _isdamaging / _iswebbed): traps (#21) and damaging terrain; injected predicates that default to absent.

Arena levels, decoys (cave_find_decoy / square_destroy_decoy), sound (MSG_TELEPORT / MSG_TPOTHER / MSG_TPLEVEL) and the monster "puzzled" message (add_monster_message): their subsystems are not modelled (sound #26, lore #19).

The player square-memory half of cave-map.c (square_memorize / mark / forget, square_know_pile / sense_pile, square_light_spot redraws) rides the map-memory layer (#24/#25); the web renderer holds its own explored set. PF_UNLIGHT's dark-memorization likewise.
expose_to_sun / is_daytime on the surface ride the town day-night cycle; arena levels are not modelled (depth 0 takes the town branch).
birth_levels_persist (CREATE_STAIRS) and show_damage (EARTHQUAKE) are options (#30); total_winner recall interplay is with RECALL's ledger.

DESTRUCTION's artifact bookkeeping (history_lose_artifact / mark_artifact_created) rides artifact upkeep (#24) - nothing marks artifacts created yet, so a destroyed artifact can regenerate; EARTHQUAKE's square_changeable artifact check IS ported (artifact piles shield their grid).

DARKEN_AREA's monster-target branch (monster_target_monster, #19) and decoy branch (monster_is_decoyed, #24); MDESC names and the MON_MSG plural grammar ride the display layer (#25) - the race name stands in for the quake messages, shown only for visible monsters.
player_handle_post_move after the quake displacement rides the teleport env's onPlayerPostMove hook (installed by wireGame).
push_object (L1166): needs the door/trap interplay (squares become unable to hold objects) - lands with trap.c (#21) / door commands (#20).
The known-object shadow cave (player->cave, obj->known) and list_object/delist_object oidx bookkeeping - knowledge system (#24); the pile map itself serves as the object list.
Mimicked-object handling (obj->mimicking_m_idx) - mimic reveal.
square_note_spot / square_light_spot redraw calls - render layer (#25).

Starting-gold deduction p->au -= object_value_real(obj, number): obj-value.c (obj-power) IS ported (obj/power.ts); at this site no gold is deducted and starting gold is HIGHER than upstream until it lands. No fake valuation is used.

eopts birth-option exclusion: birth options are not modelled, so eopts are treated as "no exclusions". This equals upstream behaviour with the default birth options (e.g. the Warrior's Word of Recall scroll, excluded only when birth_no_recall is ON, is included by default).

pack overflow reordering (combine_pack / pack_overflow): inven_carry_num and pack_slots_used are now ported (the pack-room GATE is enforced for transactions), but the reorder/overflow-slot handling on an over-fill is still DEFERRED - a birth kit never overflows.

The DISPLAY half of obj-knowledge in player_outfit (object_flavor_aware, object_set_base_known, update_player_object_knowledge) and the obj->known twin, consistent with obj/object.ts. NOT deferred: modifier-rune learning, which wieldObject now runs via object_learn_on_wield (obj/knowledge.ts) so worn pval bonuses go live immediately.
The equip_cnt UI counter (p->upkeep->equip_cnt).
The running carried-weight total (p->upkeep->total_weight beyond the reset to 0); recomputing it belongs to the calc/inventory owner.

The take-off / inventory command layer (inven_wield messaging, inven_takeoff, inven_drop) and the quiver (quiver_absorb_num, OSTACK_QUIVER handling): out of scope for the birth substrate. gear_object_for_use is now ported (used by the store transactions).
Re-deriving calc_bonuses from the populated equipment and wiring actor.weapon / actor.defense: owned by player/calcs.ts (downstream).

The full player->cave twin (known traps as trap instances, per-object known twins with pval/ego knowledge) rides object knowledge and #25; the sense markers do not record which predicate sensed them, so a know/sense of a different object class can clear them (upstream keeps per-object knowledge).

update_mon's telepathy (RF_TELEPATHY equipment), infravision, SEE_INVIS, monster_is_in_view distance/light weighting and the disturb-on-appear side effects ride the full visibility model; invisible monsters are simply never seen without detection.
square_light_spot / PR_ redraws ride presentation (the web renderer repaints fully each frame).
disturb(player), spell_message and spell_check_for_fail_rune are injected hooks: the message selection (seen / blind / save text) and the fail-rune learning are UI / lore concerns (#24).

Summon and shapechange subtypes (S_KIN, SHAPECHANGE, ...) need their name resolvers injected (mon-summon.c summon_name_to_idx, player shapes); absent, the chain cannot build and the cast fizzles via the unresolved hook. The EF_SUMMON handler itself is still a stub until monster generation lands.

choose_attack_spell / remove_bad_spells / make_attack_spell (mon-attack.c): the spell-selection AI that decides whether and which spell a monster casts on its turn - the next #19 increment; doMonSpell is the executor it calls.
Monster names are the race name until MDESC (#25); the light-purple commanded-monster highlight (ui-display.c) rides #25.
The cast branch's interactive re-target prompt (target_set_monster NULL + get_aim_dir) is UI; the player's current target stands in.
CMD_DROP no-ops: monster-held objects (mon->held_obj, get_random_monster_object) are not modelled yet.

The monster-target branches of the mon-blow-effects handlers reduce to their damage + the critical stun (blind/confuse/poison etc. on a monster victim, and the blinked teleport, ride the full mon-blow-effects monster path).
square_smash_wall's neighbour scouring reduces to the wall becoming floor; door bashing does not roll the upstream broken-vs-open split beyond square_smash_door -> BROKEN.
TMD_COMMAND's timed-effect definition messages ride the player-timed grade table (the direct field set matches player_set_timed's no-notify call).
monster_can_see (mon-util.c) IS plain line of sight in the C, so rouse using plain line of sight is exact, not a substitution (it also weighs range and light).
monster_group_index_new grows state.groups on demand rather than capping at z_info->level_monster_max, so it never returns 0 (fail); behaviour is otherwise identical.
Summon-group assignment at summon time (summon_group's caller in the EF_SUMMON handler) lands with monster summoning.
The flicker-animation attr is collected but there is no per-frame redraw in the engine (rides the front-end draw layer).

ui-mon-list.c (the terminal section headers, the "you see / are aware of N monsters" summary text, the too-many-to-fit truncation, and the map cursor tracking) is the draw half, replaced by each shell's own panel.
mon_create_drop / mon_create_mimicked_object ride the monster-inventory subsystem (monster_carry / held objects); summoned monsters carry no loot yet, and ORIGIN_DROP_SUMMON stamps with it.
add_to_monster_rating and the cheat_hear OOD messages ride level feelings (#25); num_repro counting rides breeders; the PU_UPDATE_VIEW monster-light refresh rides the FOV consumers.
Killed-unique max_num zeroes are session-lifetime only; persisting them rides the save format (a lore/race-state section, #24).
compact_monsters / monster_index_move ride the level-cap pressure path (the port's monster list grows on demand); wipe_mon_list beyond the racial-count half is the session's store swap.
The birth_ai_learn knowledge filter (unset_spells in remove_bad_spells): the AI's memory of player resists; the option is off by default.
RSF_HEAL_KIN's find_any_nearby_injured_kin scan: monster groups (#19); the injured-kin test is an injected hook, default none (so HEAL_KIN is dropped).

The monster-lore updates are DONE (mon-lore.yaml): a seen cast learns the spell flag and counts cast_innate / cast_spell, and a fatal cast counts a death. become_aware for a camouflaged caster is NOW WIRED (session/game.ts installs state.becomeAware -> game/known.ts becomeAware into installMonsterCasting's config); the failure / cast messages remain injected hooks.
The decoy target and the non-player-target witness path (square_isview along project_path): decoys and monster-vs-monster targeting are not modelled here.

The session / web layer still needs to call installMonsterCasting during startGame (with the effect registry, cast context and bound spells) to enable casting in the shipped game; the core seam and integration are complete.
do_cmd_inscribe / uninscribe / autoinscribe (setters; land with UI).
do_cmd_refill (fuel model), do_cmd_use dispatcher (UI menu), do_cmd_cast / study (player spells, #22).
The glyph-of-warding push_object interaction (traps #21).

Command repetition (can_use == 0 retry), the !t take-off confirmation and the ring-slot choice (get_check / cmd_get_item, UI #25). The shapechange gating (player_get_resume_normal_shape) is DONE (game-shape.yaml): takeoff/wield/drop and the scroll/staff/wand/rod/ activate family resume the normal form first (confirm seam, default yes); eat/quaff stay ungated as upstream.
The work_obj known-copy machinery and object descriptions (knowledge #24 / UI #25); messages are hooks.

The pickup menu (get_item over USE_FLOOR) is the chooseItem seam; the headless default picks the pile head, one object per 'g' press (ui #25 supplies the real menu, restoring the recursive menu loop).

square_know_pile / OFLOOR_VISIBLE marking (knowledge #24): every object on the grid is visible; unmarked objects cannot yet exist. This also means object_touch's find-ON-SIGHT path (square_know_pile calling it the instant a pile becomes known, not only on pickup) is not reproduced; only the pickup path fires state.onArtifactFound (ledgered in player-history.yaml).
ignore_item_ok (obj-ignore #24): isIgnored hook, nothing ignored.
get_quantity partial-pickup prompt (ui): defaults to the carryable max.
Weight tracking (p->upkeep->total_weight) and PN_IGNORE notice - with the inventory upkeep layer.

find_path uses prepare_pfdistances + pfdistances_to_path, NOT the patched-distance A* (an equal-result performance optimization); paths match upstream up to tie-breaking. The relaxation queue is a plain array shift() (upstream's q_queue); correctness is identical.

convert_turn_penalty (the door / rubble penalties assume moving costs z_info->move_energy, the common case; movement-speed class energy is unported) and compute_rubble_penalty's swap-to-best-digger recalculation (the wielded DIGGING skill decides, as in tunnelAux). compute_locked_penalty's dark / PF_UNLIGHT lighting nuance rides light. square_isdamaging is reduced to fiery terrain (lava).

Pathfinding reads live terrain gated by square_isknown rather than the remembered feat itself (identical for seen grids; only stale memory from magic mapping could differ), matching the running engine.
do_cmd_pathfind / do_cmd_explore are registered core actions but not yet wired to a web click / key (no grid-click handler exists front end); the running keypress is wired.

disturb() from events OTHER than run_test's own per-step checks (a monster waking or closing from behind, taking damage, a status message, resting). disturb() is exported so those sites call it as they land with the monster-AI / message / rest layers; run_test already stops for anything the runner moves toward.

The OF_TRAP_IMMUNE / shape-flag half of player_is_trapsafe (only the TMD_TRAPSAFE timer is read; #13 equipment flags); the running torch-radius recompute (PU_TORCH, light layer); the running-straight-into-a-trap-disarms nuance (move_player's disarm arg, trap layer); ignore_item_ok on remembered objects (#24 ignore) - any remembered floor object aborts, matching the "everything seen is known" front
player_inc_check's fail-condition messages before the confusion messages (the timed registry check runs, but the pre-check message gating is simplified to always announcing).
update_smart_learn (monster learning the player's resists) rides lore (#24); PR_MANA and the other redraw masks are display.

effect_handler_LASH (L899): the whip/spit finite beam - its damage is summed from the caster's monster blows (mon->race->blow[]), so it lands with the monster-spell layer (#19) that already has that data; the projection shape itself is a short beam (castShortBeam).
The effect-registry wiring (registering these as the EF_* handlers) and the player-timed / EffectPlayer adapters for the general handlers - next increment.
resolveAimedTarget's monster branch (confused direction, target-monster, decoy) and the target system (target_okay / target_get) - #19 / #24.
onObject (#20 floor objects) and onFeature (#21 traps/terrain) projection hooks; breath_dam for monster breath damage (#19).
A real PlayerProjActor from calc_bonuses (resists, damage reduction, minus_ac) replaces basicPlayerActor's zeroes.
square_forget / square_unmark and the PU_UPDATE_VIEW | PU_MONSTERS masks: the core keeps no player square-memory yet (the web renderer holds its own explored set); FOV refresh rides state.updateFov.
expose_to_sun / is_daytime and square_isbright's surface interplay: no town or day-night cycle yet (#24/#25).
The decoy branch (square_destroy_decoy) rides mon-desire (#24).
push_object's trap re-run (square_add_trap on the restored feature) and its queue-size cap (z_info->floor_size) are simplified: the port excises a snapshot and re-drops it.

The onKill / onMonsterDeath bodies (player_kill_monster / monster_death: experience, treasure drops, quest completion) are blocked on floor-object piles (#20), lore (#24), experience and quests; supplied as hooks.
polymorph needs monster generation (get_mon_num / place_new_monster); a hook that no-ops until then.
The teleport and thrustAway hooks are now BACKED in wireGame by teleportMonster (game/effect-teleport.ts) and thrustAway (game/thrust.ts); worldless callers still get the inert defaults.
delete_monster_idx's held-object drop, monster-group, mimic, racial-counter and targeting/redraw bookkeeping are deferred with their subsystems.
update_mon / square_light_spot / PR_MONSTER collapse into the onUpdate hook.
KILL_TRAP's chest unlock (is_locked_chest / unlock_chest): chests ride with obj-chest.c (#24).
Mimic reveal (obj->mimicking_m_idx -> become_aware): mimics are not in the live loop yet.
The protected_obj parameter (the object that created the projection): the engine's onObject hook does not thread it and no live caller projects from an object yet.
obj->known twin updates in inven_damage, ignore_item_ok checks (#24), gear_to_label lettering, PU_BONUS/PR_EQUIP redraw flags (display), and cmd_disable_repeat_floor_item.
inven_damage call sites in project-player.c (side effects computing cperc from elemental damage) land with the project-player tail.

The per-type side effects themselves (blindness from light, stun from sound, cuts from shards, poison, confusion, stat/exp drain, inventory damage) land with their subsystems and the player-timed adapter; supplied via onSideEffects.

The decoy-hit branch (square_isdecoyed / square_destroy_decoy) is omitted - decoys ARE modelled: EF_GLYPH with the DECOY subtype sets GameState.decoy (game/effect-general.ts:199), exactly as upstream creates one.
update_smart_learn (the monster learning the player's resistances) and the killer-name resolution are the caller's responsibility.

The shape blow verbs are bound but the shape unarmed attack itself (py_attack_real's player_is_shapechanged branch over shape->blows) rides the combat layer; a shapechanged player still attacks with the normal unarmed path.
TMD_ATT_VAMP's vampire-bite effect rides that timed effect's consumers; resume just clears the timer.
MON_MSG_SHAPE_FAIL's message text rides the monster-message table (#25); PR_TITLE / PR_MISC / PR_HEALTH redraws ride #25.
The commanded-monster / mimic interactions with shapes (mimicked objects) ride monster mimicry.

The interactive targeting UI (ui-target.c: the * browsing loop, look prompts, panel scrolling, path drawing) rides presentation (#25); target_pick and target_get_monsters are its complete engine half. Monster names in messages are the race name until MDESC.
panel_contains in target_sighted and restrict_to_panel in target_get_monsters are injected (panels are UI state; the default accepts everything / scans max_range as the upstream else-branch).
ignore_known_item_ok in target_accept (the ignore system is a later #24 slice); every remembered object is interesting for now. The unknown_item_kind marker is the KnownMap's null-glyph memory.

monster_race_track in target_set_closest rides monster lore (#24); healthWho covers health_track. project.c's health_track on a struck visible monster (L978) and player-attack.c's ranged-fire targeting (L1070) / fire_at_nearest (L1440) ride the missile-fire command.
cmd-core.c L959 (the cmd_get_target retry when a stale DIR_TARGET has no okay target) rides the command-prompt layer (#25).
Taking fire damage on the lava landing grid is the terrain-damage movement pass (the message is emitted here as upstream).
player_is_trapsafe and the OF save-flag equip learning ride the playerHasFlag hook (rune knowledge, #13/#24) - default: no flags, no trap immunity.
square_memorize_traps / the player's shadow cave (knowledge #24): the VISIBLE instance flag doubles as the render gate.

no_light in the unlock/disarm penalties (light model); monster glyph and web interactions in the monster AI (mon-move); trap-created terrain effects that need unported effect handlers fizzle silently.
The trapdoor persistent-levels option check (birth options).

labyrinth_gen, cavern_gen, moria_gen, lair_gen, gauntlet_gen, hard_centre_gen and arena_gen are NOT ported. Their builder keys are registered but delegate to modified_gen, and their profiles are not enabled for selection by default (createDungeonProfiles enables only town/classic/modified). choose_profile still consults find("moria") / find("labyrinth") and correctly skips them when absent. A mod
town_gen: replaced by a minimal open, lit level with a perimeter wall and one down staircase. Full town generation (stores, home, day/night monster population) is a separate later task.
Persistent-level handling: build_staircase_rooms, get_join_info, transform_join_list, connectors and the one_off_above/below avoidance are not exercised (dun.persist is always false).
Themed levels and the streamer treasure-chance nuances beyond magma/quartz upgrade.

Pit/nest monster theming (mon_restrict): pits place any depth-appropriate monster (group_ok off, as upstream). Placement RNG order therefore diverges from upstream where theming would have restricted the table; structural invariants are asserted instead. NOTE monster group/escort spawning (place_new_monster / place_friends / place_new_monster_group / the escort-base prep hook) is now PORTED in gen
place_trap only records the grid (the trap domain / trap objects are not ported); square_set_door_lock is a no-op but its RNG roll is preserved.
Arena and quest levels, persistent-level connectors (join / one_off), the known-level ("player cave") duplicate, level feeling (place_feeling / calc_*_feeling), and dump_level HTML output.
The birth_connect_stairs / birth_levels_persist player-option paths of new_player_spot (exposed as an injected createStair parameter).

nest / pit: the room shell (outer room, inner room, single door) is faithful, but monster theming is simplified - the inner room is filled with any depth-appropriate monster rather than a themed pit_profile (set_pit_type / mon_pit_hook / pit.txt selection ARE ported: gen/gen-monster.ts:205 and gen/room.ts:1341). Object rarity fill and the concentric pit monster layout are not reproduced.
vault racial glyphs (get_vault_monsters): each alphabetic racial glyph places any depth-appropriate monster (Lesser/Medium/Greater depth boost kept) rather than a base-symbol-restricted one.

build_moria, build_room_of_chambers, build_huge: registered but return false (fall through to another room profile exactly as room_build does on failure). Their profiles are not enabled for selection (see gen-cave).

random_room_template / random_vault iterate the loaded arrays in file order; upstream walks a reverse-of-file-order linked list, so the specific template/vault chosen for a given seed may differ (the reservoir draw count and uniform probability are unchanged). Not verified against a C run.

Spell / breath damage numbers (mon_spell_dam / nonhp_dam, mon-spell.c) are not bound to the casting race yet (mon/spell.ts defers them), so monSpellLoreDamage returns 0 via deps.spellLoreDamage when absent - upstream omits the "(N)" at 0 damage. The integration seam is deps.spellLoreDamage.

The player's melee hit chance (lore_append_toughness L1086) and the monster's blow hit chance / its centidamage average (lore_append_attack L1710) need the player-attack combat math + live defensive state; they are the deps.meleeHitPercent / deps.monsterHitPercent callbacks, defaulting to 0 when the combat layer does not supply them.

spell_color (mon-lore.c L59) and blow_color (L178) read the player's known_state (resists / skills / inventory) for danger colouring; defaulted to the datum's base lore colour (loreColorBase), overridable via deps.spellColor / deps.blowColor.
